title: Which menu layouts are hardest to read on a phone
body:
Open the fictional cafe example at a narrow screen width. Tell us which item names, price formats or category structures need better handling. Share synthetic examples rather than another cafe's copied menu. [Cafe Web Design](https://cafewebdesign.uk/) maintains the converter. Suggestions about menu presentation belong here; please report reproducible import or rendering errors in Issues.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/Cafe-Web-Design/cafe-menu-to-html#readme), then run the documented example locally.
